Vulnerabilities.Title: Command Injection in lodash
Vulnerabilities.Description: lodash versions prior to 4.17.21 are vulnerable to Command Injection via the template function.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Regular Expression Denial of Service in semver
Vulnerabilities.Description: semver is vulnerable to ReDoS when parsing untrusted ranges.

Misconfigurations.Title: Image user should not be 'root'
Misconfigurations.Description: Running containers as root exposes the host to privilege escalation.
Misconfigurations.Message: Specify a non-root user with the USER instruction.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add a USER instruction after installing dependencies.
